description: Reproject point clouds from EPSG:4326 (WGS84) to EPSG:27700 (OSGB36) and write compressed LAZ output.
inputInstructions: Set sourceCrs / targetCrs (EPSG codes) and outputFormats (e57, las, laz, ply). Asset metadata keys (sourceCrs, targetCrs, outputFormats, ...) override these values at run time.
